intent.rationale: A blocking state update races a separate clocked reader, allowing the reader to sample the new value instead of the old hardware state.

labels.note: blocking writes to register sample, read by another clocked process: race
A blocking write to sample races with the separate clocked process that reads it.

settlement.note: The blocking writes to sample permit the separate clocked reader to observe a newly written value depending on process scheduling. The offending statements are the blocking assignments; the nonblocking read at line 26 is otherwise correct.
